title: Chinese Premier Urges Urgent Global AI Governance to Avoid 'Losing Control'
detail: Chinese Premier called for urgent international AI governance frameworks at a high-level forum, warning that without coordinated global rules humanity risks 'losing control' of artificial intelligence systems. The statement signals China's intent to play a leading role in shaping global AI norms as competition with the US over AI leadership intensifies.

media.caption: Chinese Premier calls for international AI governance frameworks
